title: Special Permit for Certain Arenas
previewText: On Parcels B and G in the Coney West Subdistrict of the Special Coney Island District, the City Planning Commission may permit an arena in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (d) of Section 74-182 (Arenas, auditoriums, stadiums or trade expositions).

amendmentHistory.notes: Added new Section 131-16, referencing the new special permit provisions in para (d) Section 74-182 (Arenas, auditoriums, stadiums or trade expositions), which replace the deleted Section 131-60 (SPECIAL PERMIT FOR AUDITORIUMS) from the Special Coney Island District
